newsitem.title: USA: CME live cattle calls mixed, feeders higher.
newsitem.headline: CME live cattle calls mixed, feeders higher.

text.p: Early calls on CME live cattle futures ranged from 0.200 cent higher to 0.100 lower while feeder cattle were expected to open 0.100 to 0.300 cent higher, livestock analysts said.

Nearby live cattle futures were expected to show early strength following the strong tone to boxed beef and live markets. Bull spreading is also seen following Wednesday's USDA crop report which should lower feed costs near-term and increase feedlot numbers in the long term, analysts said.
Heavyweight choice boxed beef rose to $105.49 per cwt Tuesday, the highest level since December 1.
